personalitySettings.title: Assistant tone & response style
personalitySettings.maxOutputTokensNote: Caps how long a single response can be — lower is faster and more battery-friendly on phone hardware.
personalitySettings.deepResearchNote: Breaks your question into sub-questions, researches each separately, then synthesizes one answer. Several sequential model calls on the same model — noticeably slower than a normal reply, not multiple AI models running at once. Independent from the response style above: it changes how much research goes into an answer, not its tone — the two combine (e.g. Deep Research + Succinct still synthesizes a short final answer).
personalitySettings.adaptiveRoutingNote: Classifies each message and picks which downloaded model answers it (e.g. a lightweight model for small talk, a stronger one for research/comparison questions), switching between them as needed. On by default and independent from Deep Research — if it fails for any reason, chat falls back to your normal active model automatically, it never leaves you without a response.

personalDocumentsManager.hint: Import your own .txt, .md, .csv, .json, or .pdf notes — indexed on this device only, never uploaded anywhere. PDFs need selectable text (scanned/image-only pages won't extract — there's no OCR), and password-protected PDFs aren't supported.

keyStore.dbKeyCorrupt: The stored database encryption key is damaged or has an unexpected format. Fail-closed: NIDO will not overwrite it or open the database without it. If this keeps happening, reinstalling is the only recovery (existing local data cannot be decrypted without the original key).
keyStore.dbKeyReadFailed: NIDO could not read the database encryption key from the secure store. Fail-closed: no new key will be created, because that would permanently lock your existing encrypted data. Restart the app and try again.
keyStore.dbKeyWriteFailed: NIDO generated a new database encryption key but could not save it to the secure store. Fail-closed: the unsaved key was discarded and will not be used. Restart the app and try again — if this keeps happening, the device's secure storage may be damaged.
keyStore.dbKeyLost: NIDO's database encryption key is missing from the secure store, but encrypted databases still exist on this device. Fail-closed: NIDO will NOT generate a new key silently — that would strand your existing data behind an unreadable database. Your data has NOT been deleted. To use NIDO again you must explicitly choose recovery (existing encrypted data cannot be decrypted without the original key).
keyStore.p2pKeyCorrupt: This device's stored identity key is damaged or has an unexpected format. Fail-closed: NIDO will not replace it silently. Reset the identity to create a new one (you will need to re-pair your contacts).
keyStore.p2pKeyReadFailed: NIDO could not read this device's identity key from the secure store. Fail-closed: no new identity will be created, because that would silently break all your pairings. Restart the app and try again.
keyStore.p2pSignKeyCorrupt: This device's stored message-signing key is damaged or has an unexpected format. Fail-closed: NIDO will not replace it silently. Reset the identity to create a new one.
keyStore.p2pSignKeyReadFailed: NIDO could not read this device's message-signing key from the secure store. Fail-closed: no new signing key will be created. Restart the app and try again.

p2pIdentityRecovery.title: Your identity keys were lost
p2pIdentityRecovery.whatHappened: NIDO found your identity record, but the secret keys that prove it is you are gone from this phone's secure storage (keystore). This can happen after a system update, a security reset, or a failed restore.
p2pIdentityRecovery.consequence: Your old identity cannot be used anymore. Your old peers will no longer recognize you — you must re-pair with every contact. Nothing was sent on your behalf.
p2pIdentityRecovery.archived: Your old identity record was kept in the archive, so you can tell your contacts what happened.
p2pIdentityRecovery.confirmBody: Your old peers will no longer recognize you. Re-pairing with every contact will be required. This cannot be undone.
p2pIdentityRecovery.secondBody: Last chance: your old identity will be retired permanently and archived. Continue?
p2pIdentityRecovery.recovered: ✓ New identity created. Re-pair with your contacts to talk again.

keyRecovery.title: Encryption key lost
keyRecovery.whatHappened: NIDO's database encryption key is missing from this device's secure storage, but encrypted databases were found on the device. NIDO stopped here on purpose: creating a new key silently would lock your existing data behind a database it can never open again.
keyRecovery.notDeleted: Your data has NOT been deleted. The encrypted databases are still on this device, exactly as they were.
keyRecovery.cannotRecoverKey: NIDO cannot recover the missing key, and nothing you do here will bring it back. Without the original key, the existing encrypted data cannot be decrypted — by you or by NIDO.
keyRecovery.confirmBody: Recovery keeps the unreadable encrypted databases as archives (in case the original key ever reappears) and lets NIDO start as a new installation with a new key. The archived data cannot be read without the original key. This is the only way to use NIDO again.
keyRecovery.recoveryFailed: Recovery could not be completed safely. Nothing else was touched. You can try again.

aboutScreen.title: About NIDO
aboutScreen.airGappedBody: NIDO is your personal AI assistant that runs entirely on your phone — no account, no cloud, no servers. Your questions, documents, and chats stay on this device.
aboutScreen.hardwareBody: NIDO is designed to run on a phone: it keeps memory use low and watches storage so the app stays fast and responsive.
aboutScreen.benchmarkBody: NIDO measures every answer on your own phone: model load time, time to first token, tokens/sec, peak memory and which sources were used. Run the built-in evaluation from Execution Telemetry → 🧪 Evaluate to compare any installed model on the same questions, or drive it from a computer with npm run eval:device.
aboutScreen.backupBody: Create an encrypted backup, view your encryption key or rotate it.
aboutScreen.limitsBody: NIDO runs AI models inside your phone. They can be wrong or make things up, and smaller models more often. Do not rely on NIDO alone for health, legal, financial or safety decisions: check with a professional or a trusted source.
aboutScreen.privacyBody: NIDO has no accounts, no analytics and no servers of its own. The only connections it makes are the downloads you start (models and knowledge packs), and they are listed in the network log above. The full privacy policy and terms of use are in PRIVACY.md and TERMS.md in the repository.

nido.offlineQueued: out of reach · messages are queued encrypted
nido.noContactsBody: Pair your first contact in the Contacts tab: show them your QR and scan theirs (or paste it as text).
nido.howItWorksBody: Messages are encrypted on your phone and travel straight to the other NIDO over Bluetooth — no internet, no servers. If your contact isn’t within reach, the message stays in an encrypted queue and is sent only when they appear.
nido.troubleshootBody:
If it won’t connect, try in this order:

1. Restart both tablets.
2. Turn off WiFi on both (WiFi interferes with Bluetooth).
3. In Android Settings → Bluetooth, pair the tablets with each other.
4. Open NIDO and connect from here.
5. If it disconnects in background: Settings → Apps → NIDO → Battery → Unrestricted.

downloadErrors.checksumMismatch: The integrity check failed (SHA-256 mismatch), so the file was deleted. Retrying downloads it again from the start.
downloadErrors.sizeMismatch: The download failed verification: received {{received}} of {{expected}}. The incomplete file was deleted, so retrying starts from the beginning.

downloadErrors.interrupted: The download was interrupted after {{received}} of {{expected}}. The partial file was discarded, so retrying starts from the beginning.

downloadErrors.cancelled: Verification was cancelled after {{received}} of {{expected}}. Nothing was deleted — you can verify again.
